description: Defines data structures and parsing logic for 'TalkDirective' configurations, including 'TalkDirective', 'TalkDirectiveParseResult', and 'TalkDirectiveParser' with methods for parsing JSON-based directives.

classes.name: TalkDirective
classes.description: Represents configuration options for speech directives, including voice, model, speed, and other parameters.

classes.name: TalkDirectiveParseResult
classes.description: Holds the result of parsing a directive string, including the directive object, stripped text, and unknown keys.

classes.name: TalkDirectiveParser
classes.description: Provides static methods to parse text into a TalkDirectiveParseResult, extracting parameters from JSON formatted strings.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a string to extract a TalkDirective object and related information, handling JSON content and unknown keys.

methods.name: stringValue
methods.description: Helper to extract a String value from JSON dictionary for given keys.

methods.name: doubleValue
methods.description: Helper to extract a Double value from JSON dictionary for given keys.

methods.name: intValue
methods.description: Helper to extract an Int value from JSON dictionary for given keys.

methods.name: boolValue
methods.description: Helper to extract a Bool value from JSON dictionary for given keys.
